License: ISC (see day-night-toggle-LICENSE.txt)
Local adaptation retains upstream markup and CSS artwork. Uses controlled value attribute, sidebar sizing, native outer button accessibility, and reduced-motion support. System preference and persistence are handled by theme.js. No autonomous timers or system-theme overrides.
